name: tess-emu
title: TESS-EMU — a software emulator for the HELIOS-16
description: Build TESS-EMU: a C emulator that executes HELIOS-16 machine code. It loads a .hex program image, implements the full ISA in software (register file, flags, ALU, program/data memories), runs the classic add program, and prints the result of reg[0] then TESS:PASS when reg[0]==8.
context: Tiny interpreter. Memories: prog[256], mem[65536]. Registers reg[16], NZC flags. fetch -> decode -> execute loop in main. Opcode semantics identical to HELIOS-16. Program to load (given in hex in the test): set r0=5, r1=3, add, store 0x20, load r2 from 0x20; assert r2==8; print TESS:PASS. Makefile builds emu.

manifest.purpose: register file, ALU, decode/execute loop, hex loader
the add program as hex image (5+3)
